title: RFC005 S2 Stage Gate Policy (DEC-012, §12.2)
$comment: Closed envelope, v1. Carries no embedded self-hash -- like stage_gate_policy.schema.json, its identity (domain rfc005.s2-stage-gate-policy/v1) is a domain_hash over the whole validated document, computed by the module that loads it, never stored inside it. Every rate is carried in MICRO-units (a rate r is r*1e6, an integer in [0, 1000000]) because the deterministic CBOR profile these identities hash under (rfc8949-core-det-nfc-int-v0) has no float in its data model: a float floor could be validated but never hashed. The unit is in the name so the scaling cannot be forgotten at a call site. S2 is the first stage whose quality branch is 'applies' (DEC-012): the S1 policy's contract-only shape (owner R5 2026-09-07, D4) does NOT carry over, so this schema has no not_applicable quality branch at all -- a policy that skips quality is malformed, not conservative. `absolute_quality_floor_micro` must be an absolute statement about acceptable reconstruction, argued from what the product needs: the frozen-init baseline scores 0.00 exact match and emits nothing usable, so a floor set relative to that baseline is meaningless (DEC-012 warning). `relative_margin_micro` is the optional non-inferiority margin of §12.2 and may not compensate a failed floor -- the determination path in unflatten.eval.s2_gate.report enforces floor AND margin, never either/or. `critical_slices[].minimum_fidelity_micro` is the §12.2 regression margin reduced to an absolute fidelity floor for the same reason: the frozen-init baseline emits no usable slice, so a relative-to-baseline reading is vacuous at S2. `gates` is the same fifteen contract gates as stage_gate_policy.schema.json (RFC005 §14.4), kind and missing-evidence action closed; gate names must equal the s1_runner.py GateResult name literals (checked out-of-band by test_s2_stage_gate_policy.py against the runner SOURCE, never by importing it), and the module adds the distinct-1..15 and distinct-slice_id checks this schema cannot express on its own.
